about: The synthetic credentials that each E2E driver types. They are not secret: the driver sources hold them. The VM install job restores them into the redacted recipe (an entry {"sha512_crypt": value} is a password that the frontend sends as a $6$ crypt string; the VM job makes it again from the salt in the marker) (shared/e2e/publish.py), so no job publishes or passes a recipe with a secret in it. tests/unit/test_e2e_publication.py checks each value against its driver.
